question: What are the criteria for promotion to the next academic year?
expected: At least 50% of the total credits of the ensuing academic year and 90% of the total credits of the previous year, excluding the credits of the ensuing year

question: What is the punishment for carrying a mobile phone into the exam?
expected: Possession only: cancellation of the entire examination. If the phone was used or help was given: cancellation of the entire examination taken during the year plus debarment for 12 months

question: What is the weightage of the end-term examination for theory courses?
expected: 60% for the end-term examination (the remaining 40% is continuous evaluation by the teacher)

question: What financial assistance is available for full-time Ph.D. scholars?
expected: Rs 10,000 per month for full-time scholars with no other financial support, for up to five years or until the Ph.D. is completed

question: How much extra time is given to a disabled student with a scribe?
expected: One hour extra for a 3-hour paper; 1/3rd of the total duration for papers shorter than 3 hours

question: What extra arrangements will be made for disabled students in the exam?
expected: The Centre Superintendent will make extra arrangements at examination at examination centre by Scribe/Writer,one extra/separate invigilator in a separate room.

question: Are there any relaxations in minimum attendance criteria under special circumstances?
expected: The Dean/HOD can condone shortage up to 10%, and under exceptional circumstances the Vice-Chancellor can relax it by up to a further 5%

question: What is the formula for calculating Cummulative Performance Index?
expected: CPI = sum of (credits × marks) divided by sum of credits, over the courses passed with at least 50%

question: What is the punishment for impersonation in the exams?
expected: Cancellation of the entire examination taken by the candidate and further debarring him at any examination of the board during the span of three years(36 months).

question: Can I get my conference registration fee reimbursed, and what is the maximum amount?
expected: Reimbursement of the registration fee only, for Web of Science/Scopus indexed conferences, up to Rs 10,000 per conference, for one student author who presents the paper.
